criteria.description: grasped hammer head aligned above block without block contact
criteria.name: hammer_prestrike_aligned

stage_texts: Hold the hammer aligned above the target block without striking it.
Strike the target block with the hammer.

criteria.description: first RGB block is at its seed-specific target
criteria.name: ranked_prefix_at_least_1

criteria.description: first two RGB blocks are at their seed-specific targets
criteria.name: ranked_prefix_at_least_2

Place the second colored block at its ranked target.
Complete the color ranking by placing all blocks at their targets.

criteria.description: first expert-placed size block is at its target

criteria.description: desk bin is held by the left gripper above the large bin before dumping
criteria.name: left_pour_ready

stage_texts: Hold the small trash bin with the left hand in a stable pour-ready pose above the large bin.
Dump the contents of the small bin into the large bin.

criteria.description: right receiver grips the block after left donor release
criteria.name: receiver_owns_block

stage_texts: Transfer the block so the receiving hand holds it and the giving hand has released it.
Place and release the block at the final target.

criteria.description: microphone is in the handover region and retained by the donor
criteria.name: donor_presents_in_center

stage_texts: Present the microphone in the central handover region while the giving hand still holds it.
Transfer the microphone so only the receiving hand holds it.

criteria.description: right gripper securely holds the mug after handoff
criteria.name: right_receiver_owns_mug

stage_texts: Secure the mug in the receiving right hand after the handoff.
Hang the mug securely on the target rack.
Lift the playing card clearly away from the table center.
Move and release the playing card at the required final location.
Raise the laptop lid to a clearly partially open angle.
Open the laptop lid to the required final angle.
Open the microwave door about one quarter while maintaining control of the handle.
Open the microwave door to the required final angle.

criteria.description: at least one bread satisfies RoboTwin basket geometry
criteria.name: bread_count_at_least_1

stage_texts: Place one bread securely inside the basket.
Place all remaining bread securely inside the basket.

criteria.description: can contacts basket, is off the table, and lies within basket envelope

stage_texts: Place the can securely inside the basket.
Lift the basket while keeping the can inside.

criteria.description: at least one can satisfies RoboTwin box geometry
criteria.name: can_count_at_least_1

stage_texts: Place one can securely inside the plastic box.
Place both cans securely inside the plastic box.

criteria.description: at least one shoe is within the partial-placement target envelope (quaternion tolerance 0.08)
criteria.name: shoe_count_at_least_1

stage_texts: Place one shoe securely at its target location.
Place both shoes securely at their target locations.

criteria.description: object contacts basket, is off the table, and lies within basket envelope
criteria.name: object_inside_basket

stage_texts: Place the object securely inside the basket.

Place one bottle securely inside the dustbin.
